thread:
incident-bot: 🚨 Realtime alert: route 'stream.generate' p99 latency = 3.9s (SLO 1.0s) over rolling 2m window. Paging oncall.
ryan (oncall): ack. joining. hopping onto grafana now.
maya: I'm seeing a sharp increase in stream chunk latency and a bunch of stalled responses in tracer. Link: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/streams/streaming-latency?from=-10m
devin: streaming stalls look like clients receive first token then nothing for 700-1500ms, repeated. tcp retrans not high. Kernel-level wait on gpu appears elevated.
tess: any recent deploys? infra events?
ops-bot: Deployment event detected: inference-controller applied rollout rwd-stream-64b v1.9.1 -> v1.10.0 at 2026-03-16T09:45:12Z
ryan (oncall): that matches timeline. Are canaries at 5%? need to know if traffic-split changed.
maya: router shows traffic-split updated at 09:45:15 to add 5% -> variant=binary-optimized. Correlates exactly.
devin: grabbing pod-level metrics: `kubectl top pods -n inference --containers | grep rwd-stream-64b` shows one canary node with GPU utilization 98% and GPU_mem_wait spike.
leila: customer impact check: using tenant-metrics, top-tenants show three high-volume users with increased tail latencies, one spike in 502s for a major customer. Flagging to support.
ryan (oncall): prioritize containment: 1) pause rollout 2) divert traffic to stable variant 3) temporarily enable condensed streaming mode (send fewer tokens per chunk) to reduce kernel pressure. Thoughts?
tess: pause rollout first. `kubectl -n inference patch rollout rwd-stream-64b -p '{"spec":{"paused":true}}'` will stop new canary pods.
devin: traffic diversion via router API is quick: `POST /router/v1/split` with payload to set variant weights. I can flip the 5% back to stable in 30s.
leila: condense streaming mode is a good band-aid. We have a route flag `stream.chunk_size` that can be reduced to 4 tokens which reduces per-chunk overhead.
ryan (oncall): do the safe ops: devin flip traffic, tess pause rollout, maya apply stream.chunk_size=4 on the streaming route. I'll notify comms.
ops-bot: A note: cordon/evacuate would be disruptive. Recommend router-level split unless pods are unhealthy.
devin: rolling traffic change applied: `curl -X POST https://router.internal/api/split -d '{"route":"stream.generate","weights":{"stable":95,"canary":5}}'` -> success. now setting canary to 0%.
devin: updating to 0% -> success. router shows 0% traffic to canary.
tess: pausing rollout now: `kubectl -n inference patch rollout rwd-stream-64b -p '{"spec":{"paused":true}}'` -> ok. rollout paused.
maya: applying stream chunk size change: `route-config set stream.generate stream.chunk_size=4 --apply` -> 200 OK. pushing config.
ryan (oncall): monitoring dashboards; p95 dropped from ~1.8s to 650ms, p99 from 3.9s to 1.05s. Still marginally above SLO but trending down.
leila: notifying support and affected customers with initial note. ETA for next update 10 minutes. Marking incident as active.
devin: collecting canary pod logs and stack traces for kernel path: `kubectl logs -n inference pod/rwd-stream-64b-canary-xyz --since=20m > /tmp/canary-logs-1768123000.log` and saving to artifacts.
maya: trace snippet shows `wait_for_copy` at GPU memcpy boundary and repeated `KVCache::miss` traces for identical prefixes. Suspect cache eviction pressure on canary.
ryan (oncall): good call. Can we temporarily turn on prefix sticky caching for stream.generate to reduce cache churn?
devin: enabling prefix sticky: `route-config set stream.generate prefix_cache=sticky --apply` -> OK.
ryan (oncall): after sticky cache enabled, p99 dropped to 880ms, p95 520ms. We'll continue observing. main customer errors reduced to background rate.
leila: prepping status update for customers: short summary + affected services + mitigation steps. Posting to status.redwood.example shortly.
ops-bot: Reminder: on-call handoff scheduled at 10:00 UTC. If still active, please coordinate.
tess: side note: canary image includes updated cuda kernels flagged in release notes. We should add latency health check on canary gates next time.
devin: saved artifact: /artifacts/incident-1768123000/traces.tar.gz
ryan (oncall): next steps: 1) keep paused and at 0% for now 2) full root-cause triage with eng-runtime for kernel selection and cache behavior 3) add correlated alert that links rollout events + p99 spikes, and a canary latency gate to CI.
maya: assigning follow-ups to eng-runtime and infra. I'll add detailed timeline and attach traces.
leila: will follow up with customer comms and update the status page in 15m.
ryan (oncall): thanks everyone. I'll leave the incident open for 30 more minutes to ensure stability, then start handoff if stable. :white_check_mark:
